title: ProBuild Perk Reward Schedule
content:
Perks points under Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards are exchanged for perk rewards in fixed blocks. This schedule sets, per tier, the points that make one perk reward, the value of one perk reward, how long it stays usable, the largest value of perk rewards issued to a member in one program year, and whether a perk reward may be used on a purchase priced under a volume pricing quote.

| Tier | Points redeemed for one perk reward | Value of one perk reward | Days after issue a perk reward stays usable | Largest total value of perk rewards issued in one program year | Usable on a purchase priced under a volume pricing quote |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 2500 | USD 25.00 | 60 | USD 500.00 | No |
| ProBuild Bronze | 2500 | USD 25.00 | 60 | USD 750.00 | No |
| ProBuild Silver | 2500 | USD 25.00 | 90 | USD 1000.00 | No |
| ProBuild Gold | 2000 | USD 25.00 | 90 | USD 2500.00 | No |
| ProBuild Platinum | 2000 | USD 25.00 | 120 | USD 5000.00 | No |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 1500 | USD 25.00 | 120 | USD 10000.00 | No |

A perk reward is worth USD 25.00 at every tier, and at no tier may it be used on a purchase priced under a volume pricing quote.

## The yearly ceiling expressed in perk rewards

Dividing each tier's yearly ceiling by the USD 25.00 value of one perk reward gives the number of perk rewards that ceiling allows in a program year, and multiplying that number by the tier's block size gives the points those rewards consume.

| Tier | Perk rewards the yearly ceiling allows | Points those perk rewards consume |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Member | 20 | 50000 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 30 | 75000 |
| ProBuild Silver | 40 | 100000 |
| ProBuild Gold | 100 | 200000 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 200 | 400000 |
| ProBuild Platinum Elite | 400 | 600000 |
